title: How many 30-tablet bottles of TLD a national Central Medical Stores should order for January to June 2027, when a late-diagnosed cohort of children born in 2015-16 is being weighed into the 30 kg dosing band
subdomain: utilization, access and demand forecasting (a national ARV quantification: the C7 order of the adult TLD pack, the paediatric regimen transitions forecast child by child from the register's scheduled weighings)
prompt_shape: a committed order of TLD bottles for one cycle with the projection's consumption and maximum stock and the stock and shipments it nets, each region's CMS deliveries and reported dispensing over the last two closed cycles, and a chart of those deliveries and that dispensing by region for each cycle, every bar labelled
